question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom that can be substituted in the following sentence.**

He was murdered __in cold blood__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**deliberately**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom is '**deliberately**'.
 
• **In cold blood: **in a cruel way and without pity/ intentionally and without emotion. (क्रूरता या निर्ममता से/ जानबूझकर और भावना के बिना)
 
 
• *Example: to kill somebody** in cold blood**...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *deliberately.*
